<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Ember & Oak — Order Desk</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#FAF7F2;--surface:#FFFFFF;--surface-alt:#F3EFE8;--border:#E5DFD6;--border-strong:#D6CFC3;--text:#1A1815;--text-secondary:#6B655C;--text-tertiary:#9A938A;--accent:#C2410C;--accent-hover:#9A3412;--accent-soft:#FDF0E8;--shadow-sm:0 1px 2px rgba(26,24,21,.05);--shadow-md:0 4px 16px rgba(26,24,21,.07);--radius:10px;--radius-sm:6px;--font-display:Georgia,'Iowan Old Style','Times New Roman',serif;--font-body:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;--transition:150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
body{font-family:var(--font-body);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button{font-family:var(--font-body)}
.app-shell{display:flex;min-height:100vh}
.sidebar{width:232px;background:var(--surface);border-right:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:24px 16px;position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;flex-shrink:0}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:0 8px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:16px}
.brand-mark{width:36px;height:36px;flex-shrink:0}
.brand-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px}
.brand-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--text);line-height:1.2}
.brand-sub{font-size:10px;color:var(--text-tertiary);letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase}
.nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;flex:1}
.nav-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 12px;border:none;background:transparent;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-secondary);cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--transition),color var(--transition);text-align:left;width:100%}
.nav-item:hover{background:var(--surface-alt);color:var(--text)}
.nav-item.active{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
.nav-item svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex-shrink:0}
.sidebar-footer{padding:16px 8px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);font-size:11px;color:var(--text-tertiary);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.main{flex:1;padding:32px 40px;max-width:1280px;min-width:0}
.view{display:none}
.view.active{display:block;animation:fadeIn 180ms ease-out}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.page-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:24px;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.page-header h1{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:28px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--text);line-height:1.2}
.date-range{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-secondary);margin-top:4px}
.header-actions{display:flex;gap:8px}
